entities.summary: Chukwuebuka Obi-Uchendu is a Nigerian media personality. He is known for hosting the reality show Big Brother Naija, the talk show Rubbin' Minds on Channels TV as well as co-hosting The Spot and Men's Corner on Ebonylife television. He is an ambassador for Budweiser Nigeria, Samsung Nigeria, and 2Sure Nigeria.
